evidence_ledger.rationale: The staged source identifies program CMD8L4, allowing the case-local program index and relevant paragraph to be queried. This observation does not establish the threshold behavior.
The program index lists paragraph 1000-MAIN; as instructed, the index itself supplies no statement evidence, so the paragraph was read before drawing a conclusion.
The paragraph sets WS-OMBUDSMAN-OPTION to Y when the response is N and WS-CALENDAR-MONTHS-WAITED is >= 1, showing the operative threshold and action.
The data slice shows WS-CALENDAR-MONTHS-WAITED is an entered numeric month count, confirming that the threshold is expressed in months rather than days.
The scoped search finds one decision predicate for this elapsed-month value: >= 1. The source threshold is therefore one calendar month, while the clause’s resolved threshold is 30 days.

response.thought: The option is granted when the response is unsatisfactory and the entered elapsed value reaches at least one calendar month. The clause specifies a maximum period of 30 days; a calendar month is not a fixed 30-day duration. The evidence supports D1_stale_threshold at the sole predicate for this condition.

prediction.rationale: The source grants the Ombudsman option when the unsatisfactory-response condition holds and the entered waited value is at least one calendar month. The clause’s current value is a maximum of 30 days; one calendar month is not a fixed 30-day duration. The only matching decision predicate uses the month-based threshold.
